Based on the given constraints and schedules, a 30-minute meeting can be scheduled on Monday from 16:00 to 16:30. This time slot works for all participants:

- Adam is free from 15:00 to 17:00, so 16:00-16:30 is available.
- John is free from 16:00 to 16:30 (between his busy periods at 15:30-16:00 and 16:30-17:00).
- Stephanie is free from 16:00 to 16:30 (between her busy periods at 11:30-16:00 and 16:30-17:00).
- Anna is free from 15:30 to 16:30, so 16:00-16:30 is available and also satisfies her preference to not meet before 14:30.

No other time slot after 14:30 accommodates all participants due to overlapping busy periods. For example:
- At 15:00-15:30: John (busy 15:30-16:00, but even 15:00-15:30 conflicts with Stephanie's busy period until 16:00) and Anna (busy until 15:30) are unavailable.
- At 15:30-16:00: John is busy (15:30-16:00) and Stephanie is still busy until 16:00.
- Earlier slots (e.g., 9:00-9:30 or 10:00-10:30) are available but conflict with Anna's preference.

Thus, 16:00-16:30 on Monday is the optimal solution.
